lens: Data meaning and status preservation. All seven pairs inspected. Scores cover visible presentation only; no interaction testing or measured accessibility. No score drops.

findings: Before hierarchy and typography/numbers: regular-weight account names compete with secondary quota labels while percentages dominate. Use semibold account names; the after image addresses this.
Both layout: the warning labels and their 0% or 14% values are separated by substantial empty space. Bring each warning value closer to its label while preserving the weekly percentage column.
Both content: Cloud Session Credits at 0% is described only as Low. Use an explicit exhausted or none-remaining label at zero to distinguish it from the 14% warning.
After preserves all three 82.8% values, both warning values and labels, loaded/eligible counts, chevrons, and Expand All.

Before hierarchy and typography/numbers: account names lack a clear weight distinction from quota labels. Use semibold account names; the after image supplies that distinction without visible wrapping.
Both content: Low understates the distinction between Cloud Session Credits at 0% and the 5-Hour Limit at 14%. Label the zero balance as exhausted or none remaining.
After preserves the three-column layout, all percentages, warning text, counts, and visible disclosure controls.
Before hierarchy and typography/numbers: account names and warning descriptions have similar visual emphasis. Use semibold names; the after image improves account identification.
Both content: Cloud Session Credits at 0% remains labelled Low. Use explicit zero-remaining wording so its meaning differs from the 14% warning.
After retains all account rows, weekly percentages, warnings, and counts. The header and Expand All remain visible, with no visible text clipping in this crop.

Before hierarchy and typography/numbers: the multiline credential name has the same weight as supporting text. Use semibold account names; after improves grouping while preserving the full label across three lines.
Both content: Cloud Session Credits at 0% is labelled Low. Replace that zero-balance status with exhausted or none remaining.
After preserves the unavailable weekly value as a dash with Weekly quota unavailable, alongside the separate 5-Hour Limit warning at 14%. It does not visually substitute zero for unavailable data.
The long name wraps differently after, but no text loss, added line, or collision with 82.8% is visible.
Before hierarchy and typography/numbers: account identities are less distinct than their percentages and supporting status text. Use semibold names; after addresses this.
Both content: 2 loaded does not specify what loaded, although three accounts are displayed. Label the count as weekly quotas loaded, or use another precise description of the counted data.
Both content: Cloud Session Credits at 0% is only Low. Give zero remaining an explicit exhausted status.
After preserves account 3's dash and Weekly quota unavailable message, the two available weekly percentages, both warnings, and the 2 loaded / 3 eligible counts.

Both hierarchy: the stale 82.8% retains the same strong numeric emphasis as current values, while Stale is lighter-weight text. Group Stale and 82.8% in a distinct status treatment so freshness qualifies the number at first glance.
Before typography/numbers: account names have insufficient weight distinction from supporting labels. The after image's semibold names resolve this specific issue.
Both content: 2 loaded is ambiguous when three numeric weekly values are visible, including one marked Stale. State what the count includes and whether stale values are excluded.
Both content: Cloud Session Credits at 0% is described as Low. Use explicit exhausted or none-remaining wording.

Before hierarchy and typography/numbers: account names share the regular weight of nearby details. Use semibold names while keeping Pro · 100 pts secondary; after does this.
Before layout and consistency: footer labels and values start left of the quota-detail text above them. Align footer content with the detail column; after visibly improves that alignment.
Both content: Predicted empty and Burn, last 3h do not name their quota scope. Label the affected quota, and explain how an empty prediction after Weekly Reset should be interpreted.
Both content: labels such as 5-Hour Limit and 7-Day Opus do not locally specify whether percentages represent remaining or used allowance. Add Remaining to the detail heading or percentage column.
Both content: Cloud Session Credits at 0% is labelled Low. Use explicit exhausted or none-remaining wording.
